conventions.tag_format: @<asset_id> — use these tags inside video prompts; resolve each tag to the asset's `file` as an image reference attachment
conventions.file_naming: <asset_id>_v<version>.png; bumping a version means adding a new entry version and updating `file` + `version`, never deleting history
conventions.rule: Video prompts must only reference assets with status 'approved'. Reference the tag, do not re-describe the asset from scratch — the reference image is the source of truth for appearance.

assets.name: Mom
assets.description: Mom character sheet. Signature look: red polka dot apron, round glasses.
assets.prompt_usage: Attach mom_sheet_v2.png as the character reference. In prompt text, refer to her as 'the mom (@mom, as shown in reference)'. Do not restate wardrobe details unless a scene changes them — the sheet defines them.

assets.name: Kitchen
assets.description: Primary kitchen location where the pancake action takes place.
assets.prompt_usage: Attach kitchen_v1.png as the environment/set reference. In prompt text: 'in the kitchen (@kitchen, as shown in reference)'. Keep camera and layout consistent with the reference image.

assets.name: Frying Pan
assets.description: Frying pan prop sheet. Includes a red arrow annotation pointing at the handle grip (marks the exact grip point for hand interactions).
canonical_features: annotation: red arrow marks the handle grip point (annotation only — must NOT appear in rendered video)
assets.prompt_usage: Attach pan_v3_arrow.png as the prop reference. When a character grabs or holds the pan, specify: 'grips the pan at the point indicated by the red arrow in the reference'. Always add that the arrow is an annotation and must not appear in the output.

history.note: Approved final. Red arrow grip annotation added in this version.
